component: RC access-log process and native asynchronous transport adapter
selection: RC-owned Logger/AccessLog/AccessLogClient; AccessLogProtocol inherits pristine native Text encoding and decoding and bounds only individual input frames. Native Worker/TCP/AsyncTcpConnection/Timer/Select sources are unchanged.
reason: Bound diagnostic queues and connection lifetimes, escape fields and safe filenames, isolate disk/network failures, and avoid automatic replay of uncertain writes.
semantics: Best effort, not a durable or authenticated audit protocol. Queue/ok acknowledgements do not confirm persistent disk delivery. Private runtime storage and local numeric-IP endpoints are recommended; native hostname resolution may block.
scope: Workerman mainline; legacy sequential Swoole table draining is retained without new Swoole acceptance. Micro/encrypted startup, wider event-loop/TLS combinations and sustained resources remain separate gates.
